items.quote: It is not meet so to do; for we shall sacrifice the abomination of the Egyptians to the LORD our God
items.claim: Sacrificing the abomination of the Egyptians is not appropriate or lawful

items.quote: shall we sacrifice the abomination of the Egyptians before their eyes, and will they not stone us?
items.claim: If they sacrifice Egyptian animals before Egyptians, the Egyptians will stone them

items.quote: We will go three days' journey into the wilderness, and sacrifice to the LORD our God, as he shall command us
items.claim: They will journey three days into the wilderness and sacrifice to the LORD as commanded
items.place: three days' journey into the wilderness
